questions.question: After a network drop you hit retry. What must the front end send?
options: Only the user message that failed
The entire conversation history, resent verbatim
Just the auth headers — the server restores the session itself
Nothing — the server fills in the missing context
questions.explanation: See the "It starts with one click" section: the server is stateless, so retry means resending the entire history verbatim, not just the failed line.

questions.question: When is the concurrency slot held by a streaming request released?
options: When the front end renders the last character
The moment the request leaves the queue and starts inference
questions.explanation: See the "Tokenization and queueing" section: the slot is held from the moment the request is sent until the stream fully ends — released when the whole stream ends, not when the first token returns.

questions.question: The page shows a long silence and then the entire answer appears at once. What is the most likely cause?
options: The server skipped the sentinel data: [DONE] frame
Heartbeat comment lines saturated the connection
A reverse proxy or gateway on the path buffered the whole response
The front end read the delta from the wrong field
questions.explanation: See the "SSE streaming" section: some reverse proxies and gateways buffer the whole response by default, degrading streaming into collect-then-send.
